quotes.name: Deploy to the Front
quotes.flavor:
"We will descend upon you like a plague of locusts to purge you from our lands!"
—Hirov, commander of the Thousand Swords

quotes.name: Inga Rune-Eyes
quotes.flavor: Every path ever charted by an Omenseeker is etched into her eyes.

quotes.name: Wall of Omens
quotes.flavor:
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi."
—Expedition journal entry

quotes.name: Iron Myr
quotes.flavor: The myr are like rusted metal: gleaming purpose hidden by a thin disguise of debris.

quotes.name: Silver Myr
quotes.flavor: The vedalken saw the myr as toys, unaware of the intelligence lurking behind their empty eyes.

quotes.name: Sulfurous Mire
quotes.flavor:
"In my youth, we used to best each other at hopping rabbit-fast between the lava spouts, the burning tar spattering our legs."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

quotes.name: Heartfire Immolator
quotes.flavor: "I'd rather go out in a blaze of glory than fade away and be forgotten."

quotes.name: Mathemagics
quotes.flavor:
"Theory? Meet practice."
—Tam, Quandrix second-year

quotes.name: Cast into the Fire
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"But for Gollum, I could not have destroyed the Ring. So let us forgive him! For the Quest is achieved, and now all is over."
—Frodo

quotes.name: Myr Retriever
quotes.flavor: Mephidross gives up treasure easily . . . as long as you take its place.

quotes.name: Treachery
quotes.flavor:
"The academy educates; I employ. It's a perfect arrangement."
—Gatha, Tolarian renegade

quotes.name: Garrison Griffin
quotes.flavor: The keen-eyed guardians of Ardenvale are ever on alert.

quotes.name: Into the Wilds
quotes.flavor:
"Wonders hide where the trees grow thickest."
—Mul Daya proverb

quotes.name: Farmstead Gleaner
quotes.flavor: When it finishes the harvest, you'll have nowhere to hide.

quotes.name: Lava Axe
quotes.flavor: Meant to cut through the body and burn straight to the soul.

quotes.name: Wash Away
quotes.flavor:
"May the ocean take it"
—Nephalia expression meaning
"good riddance"

quotes.name: Unburial Rites
quotes.flavor: All crave the Blessed Sleep. Few receive it.

quotes.name: Fact or Fiction
quotes.flavor: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

quotes.name: Ballot Broker
quotes.flavor:
"Merchants and politicians differ only in name."
—Queen Marchesa

quotes.name: Elvish Spirit Guide
quotes.flavor:
"We are never without guidance, if we but seek it."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

quotes.name: Might of the Masses
quotes.flavor: The Joraga elves never need ask a troll to leave their territory. They merely grant it their combined strength, and it can't resist embarking on a merry rampage.

quotes.name: Brago, King Eternal
quotes.flavor: "My rule persists beyond death itself."

quotes.name: High Tide
quotes.flavor: "There's nothing like the high seas to clear your head or escape pursuers."

quotes.name: Reef Pirates
quotes.flavor:
"Zeki sails with a dead crew not out of villainy, but pragmatism."
—Baron Sengir

quotes.name: Rushwood Dryad
quotes.flavor: Rushwood is a living jewel that reflects its dwellers' hearts.

quotes.name: Tempest of Light
quotes.flavor: "Let everything return to its true nature, so that destiny may take its course."

quotes.name: Transmutation
quotes.flavor: "You know what I was,/ You see what I am: change me, change me!" —Randall

quotes.name: Horror of the Broken Lands
quotes.flavor: It feeds on dry bones in the sand and desperate pleas in the wind.

quotes.name: Baral, Chief of Compliance
quotes.flavor: In light of his zealous defense of Kaladesh, the Consulate was willing to overlook any previous transgressions.

quotes.name: Secure the Wastes
quotes.flavor: Bashenga was the first Black Panther. Wise and fearless, he closed the Great Mound and formed a militia that would guard it against all intruders.

quotes.name: Jace's Projection
quotes.flavor: "Pardon me if I seem distracted. Part of me is reconnoitering the Tenth District."

quotes.name: Vault of Whispers
quotes.flavor: Ish Sah, den of the warlord Geth, commander of countless nim.

quotes.name: Stifle
quotes.flavor:
"If I wanted your opinion, I'd have told you what it was."
—Pemmin, Riptide survivor

quotes.name: Minotaur Sureshot
quotes.flavor: "Those wings are no advantage. I will pin them to the ceiling of the Hekma."

quotes.name: Endless Ranks of HYDRA
quotes.flavor:
"It matters not how many times we are defeated. HYDRA is eternal."
—Baron Strucker

quotes.name: Truce
quotes.flavor:
Not all victories require defeat.
—Onean idiom

quotes.name: Auntie's Sentence
quotes.flavor: "Stop whining, elf. The rest of us can see that it's *perfectly* fair, heh!"

quotes.name: Penumbra Bobcat
quotes.flavor: This cat has two lives and it's hunting for more.

quotes.name: Chrome Companion
quotes.flavor: Liberation Station's morale greatly improved after Rover took up residence.

quotes.name: Midgar, City of Mako // Reactor Raid
quotes.flavor: A triumph of technology and testament to man's potential.

quotes.name: Ajani's Pridemate
quotes.flavor:
"We must never stoop to violence in the name of conquest or hatred, but when evil threatens, we must face it with courage and ferocity."
—Ajani Goldmane

quotes.name: Thriving Heath
quotes.flavor: Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.

quotes.name: Pride of Lions
quotes.flavor: There's only one thing worse than a hungry lion—many hungry lions.

quotes.name: Sengir Autocrat
quotes.flavor:
"A thankless job, and a death sentence besides."
—Eron the Relentless

quotes.name: Kozilek, the Great Distortion
quotes.flavor: A void as cryptic as reality itself.

quotes.name: Weather the Storm
quotes.flavor: "Quell your ego and anywhere can be as calm as a hurricane's eye."

quotes.name: Vorthos, Steward of Myth
quotes.flavor: "Just wait, my Madara deck isn't all Emperor Bolas. There's an Umezawa subtheme!"

quotes.name: Stunning Reversal
quotes.flavor: The line between victory and defeat can be as slim as a razor's edge.

quotes.name: Fog
quotes.flavor:
"I fear no army or beast, but only the morning fog. Our assault can survive everything else."
—Lord Hilneth

quotes.name: Sunken Ruins
quotes.flavor: Without the care of the tideshapers, the Lanes lie neglected. Some have flooded entire towns; others dried to cracked mud.

quotes.name: Zombie Goliath
quotes.flavor:
"Removing the encumbrance of useless brain tissue grants several advantages: a slight increase in mobility, a response of revulsion and horror from the enemy, and, in the case of large specimens, room for passengers."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

quotes.name: Voldaren Ambusher
quotes.flavor: "Gotcha."

quotes.name: Shattered Sanctum
quotes.flavor: The Quietus Cult holds their grim ceremonies in the dark places where unburied dead litter the ground.

quotes.name: Aether Tradewinds
quotes.flavor: Consulate engineers have developed safe methods of harvesting aether, but renegades aren't always so careful.

quotes.name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
quotes.flavor: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

quotes.name: Dragon Whelp
quotes.flavor:
"O to be a dragon . . . of silkworm size or immense . . ."
—Marianne Moore, "O to Be a Dragon"

quotes.name: Goldberry, River-Daughter
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "Fear nothing! For tonight you are under the roof of Tom Bombadil."

quotes.name: Wild Wurm
quotes.flavor:
Wurm heads appear
Wild wurm near
Wurm tails you see
Wild wurm flee

quotes.name: Territorial Baloth
quotes.flavor: Its territory is defined by wherever it is at the moment.

quotes.name: Price of Progress
quotes.flavor: Enthusiasm can be tempered in the furnace of the earth.

quotes.name: Cadaver Imp
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
quotes.flavor: The mouth must be pried open before rigor mortis sets in. Otherwise the returning soul can find no ingress.

quotes.name: Soul of Emancipation
quotes.flavor: Light poured from every crack as the sleepers awoke from their long stone slumber.

quotes.name: Mentor of the Meek
quotes.flavor: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

quotes.name: Armor of Shadows
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"What's softer than silk, stronger than steel, and quieter than thought?"
—Warlock riddle

quotes.name: Nature's Lore
quotes.flavor: Every seed planted is another lesson the forest can teach us.

quotes.name: Chorus of Might
quotes.flavor:
"In each of us is the strength of all of us."
—Trostani

quotes.name: Teferi, Mage of Zhalfir
quotes.flavor: To save this plane, he must forsake all others.

quotes.name: Sengir Vampire
quotes.flavor: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

quotes.name: Necrotic Sliver
quotes.flavor: Though Volrath is long dead, the slivers have become everything he wanted them to be: mindless instruments of destruction and despair.

quotes.name: Treasonous Ogre
quotes.flavor:
"Everything comes with a price. Especially revolution."
—Grenzo, dungeon warden

quotes.name: Fresh Meat
quotes.flavor: A scavenger's favorite appetizer is death.

quotes.name: Assault Intercessor
quotes.flavor: A foe without honour is a foe already beaten.

quotes.name: Wasteland
quotes.flavor: 2013 Legacy Championship Winner

quotes.name: Roiling Regrowth
quotes.flavor:
"Roots find their way through rock, and even mountains must give way to new growth."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Agonizing Remorse
quotes.flavor:
「罪悪感は赦しではない。後悔は正義ではない。だたし、苦しむことは正しい。」
—-エクスタス・ナー

quotes.name: Claws of Valakut
quotes.flavor: "Swords may sunder. Shields may fail. My will is stronger than steel, and my flesh and bone far more deadly."

quotes.name: Lurking Predators
quotes.flavor: All are prey to the eyes of the wild.

quotes.name: Alela, Artful Provocateur
quotes.flavor: "Rankle's pranks are child's play. My games will topple kingdoms."

quotes.name: Stampeding Wildebeests
quotes.flavor: The most violent and destructive storms in Femeref occur on cloudless days.

quotes.name: Wall of Caltrops
quotes.flavor: "Ow! Ow ow ow! Oooh, ow, OW!"

quotes.name: Silent-Chant Zubera
quotes.flavor: When the Honden of Cleansing Fire was abandoned, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to erode mortal will.

quotes.name: Blasphemous Act
quotes.flavor: In the roiling depths of the Eye of Terror, the bloodthirsty hordes of Chaos Marines plot the downfall of their loyalist brethren.

quotes.name: Faith Healer
quotes.flavor: The power of faith is quiet. It is the leaf unmoved by the hurricane.

quotes.name: Syphon Essence
quotes.flavor: The third step in creating a skaab requires draining the body of blood and replacing it with *viscus vitae*, a mixture of angel's blood and lamp oil.

quotes.name: Opulent Palace
quotes.flavor:
"The people must know that the former seat of their oppression is cleansed. Throw open Qarsi's gates and let them see for themselves."
—Kotis, the Fangkeeper

quotes.name: Cinder Elemental
quotes.flavor: Their rage can grow to such proportions that they explode in a cloud of fire.

quotes.name: Invisibility
quotes.flavor: Verick held his breath. Breathing wouldn't reveal his position, but it would force him to smell the goblins.

quotes.name: Jaya's Immolating Inferno
quotes.flavor: Centuries ago, a pyromancer's spark ignited a fiery conflagration.

quotes.name: Oboro, Palace in the Clouds
quotes.flavor: The Brandywine flowed slow and broad before them. A large flat ferry-boat was moored beside the landing.

quotes.name: Corrupted Grafstone
quotes.flavor: It is all too easy to disturb the Blessed Sleep.

quotes.name: Demolisher Spawn
quotes.flavor: It rips through the Hauntwoods like a chainsaw, leaving a crushed and bloody trail behind.

quotes.name: Ojer Axonil, Deepest Might // Temple of Power
quotes.flavor: Chimil gave the Oltec passion. Ojer Axonil challenged them to harness it.

quotes.name: Chromatic Lantern
quotes.flavor: Dimir mages put the lanterns to good use, creating shapeshifters and sleeper agents from mana foreign to them.

quotes.name: Highborn Ghoul
quotes.flavor:
"All the dead sleep lightly here, no matter how refined their beds may be."
—Grafdigger Wulmer

quotes.name: Demonic Gifts
quotes.flavor: It began as a flavor on the tongue, like a bloody morsel of roast boar—but soon the power was a conflagration in her veins.

quotes.name: Warped Tusker
quotes.flavor: Once, foraging for truffles, the very average boar fell asleep beneath the moon . . . .

quotes.name: Congregate
quotes.flavor:
"In the gathering there is strength for all who founder, renewal for all who languish, love for all who sing."
—*Song of All*, canto 642

quotes.name: Concentrate
quotes.flavor: "The treasure in my mind is greater than any worldly glory."

quotes.name: Crystalline Sliver
quotes.flavor: Bred as living shields, these slivers have proven unruly—they know they cannot be caught.

quotes.name: Nephalia Smuggler
quotes.flavor: "My drivers are trustworthy. I removed their tongues myself. Any other questions?"

quotes.name: Speaker of the Heavens
quotes.flavor: "All are welcome in the angels' light."

quotes.name: Explosive Vegetation
quotes.flavor: Torching Krosa would be pointless. It grows faster than it burns.

quotes.name: Ghoulcaller's Accomplice
quotes.flavor: "Once in the box, we're all the same."

quotes.name: Granite Gargoyle
quotes.flavor:
"While most overworlders fortunately don't realize this, Gargoyles can be most delicious, providing you have the appropriate tools to carve them."
—Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar,
*The Underworld Cookbook*

quotes.name: Crystacean
quotes.flavor: It loves blending into its environment, ambushing prey, and long scuttles on the beach.

quotes.name: Dracogenesis
quotes.flavor:
"Let the dragonstorms rage. Let what seeks sustenance feed. Let Tarkir be what it was always meant to be."
—Sarkhan

quotes.name: Volunteer Militia
quotes.flavor: After making the Peach Garden Oath, the three brothers raised an army of 500 youths to fight the Yellow Scarves rebellion.

quotes.name: Prismatic Lens
quotes.flavor: It bends not light but mana, aligning its chaotic currents into the sharp angles necessary for the mystic's purposes.

quotes.name: End of the Hunt
quotes.flavor: Just because the Oriq have gone silent doesn't mean their Mage Hunters have vanished.

quotes.name: Utter End
quotes.flavor:
"I came seeking a challenge. All I found was you."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

quotes.name: Opal Lake Gatekeepers
quotes.flavor: Sentries guard Ravnica's landmarks and outlying districts, unaware of these places' import to the maze.

quotes.name: Big Winner
quotes.flavor: The results of the test of strength were: Yes.

quotes.name: Amazing Acrobatics
quotes.flavor: "Hey, who added these deadly laser beams? Rude."

quotes.name: Chitinous Graspling
quotes.flavor: It had observed the twinkling object from afar, then found a form to sate its curiosity.

quotes.name: Spiteful Bully
quotes.flavor: Like most creatures bent on total destruction, they rarely bother to double-check their targets.

quotes.name: Abyssal Specter
quotes.flavor:
"Open the gates, and bid them enter."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Shock
quotes.flavor:
Lightning tethers souls to the world.
—Kor saying

quotes.name: Monastery Swiftspear
quotes.flavor: The calligraphy of combat is written with strokes of sudden blood.

quotes.name: Vance's Blasting Cannons // Spitfire Bastion
quotes.flavor: Now instead of a ship, Ripley Vance commands a fortress.

quotes.name: Mornsong Aria
quotes.flavor: Maralen is more forgiving than Oona was, but her rule is no less absolute.

quotes.name: Lie in Wait
quotes.flavor: Some paths through Gurmag Swamp are deserted for good reason.

quotes.name: Ingot Chewer
quotes.flavor: Elementals are ideas given form. This one is the idea of "smashitude."

quotes.name: Elrond, Lord of Rivendell
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "This is the hour of the Shire-folk, when they arise from their quiet fields to shake the towers and counsels of the Great. Who of all the Wise could have foreseen it?"

quotes.name: Dockside Chef
quotes.flavor: The squirming is how you know it's fresh.

quotes.name: Winter Orb
quotes.flavor: Amazing how you can make such a dense little ball out of thirty-plus years of other people's frustration.

quotes.name: Fortified Village
quotes.flavor:
"Our villages are the lifeblood of Wakanda. When the common people prosper, so do we."
—Queen Mother Ramonda

quotes.name: Threads of Disloyalty
quotes.flavor:
"Over time, Konda grew ever more suspicious, fearing even his most loyal allies were being manipulated by unseen hands."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Insurrection
quotes.flavor:
"Maybe they wanted to be on the winning side for once."
—Matoc, lavamancer

quotes.name: Pyroclasm
quotes.flavor:
"When the air burns, only death breathes deep."
—Bogardan mage

quotes.name: All Is Dust
quotes.flavor:
"The emergence of the Eldrazi isn't necessarily a bad thing, as long as you've already lived a fulfilling and complete life without regrets."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

quotes.name: Talon Sliver
quotes.flavor: "Keep them at sword's length!" Gerrard's order fell flat as each sliver's talon suddenly grew longer. "Hold on—break out the polearms!"

quotes.name: Gruul Signet
quotes.flavor: Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.

quotes.name: Trustworthy Scout
quotes.flavor: "Don't worry. If you lose me I'll be right behind you."

quotes.name: Streetbreaker Wurm
quotes.flavor: The Orzhov run a construction unit whose only business is rebuilding the wreckage left in the wake of wurms. When business is slow, they pay Golgari carnomancers to lure the wurms to the surface.

quotes.name: Unholy Heat
quotes.flavor: "The devils use fire. Why shouldn't we?"

quotes.name: Indomitable Will
quotes.flavor:
"Charge bravely. Fight selflessly. Act honorably. Iroas will watch over you."
—Verenis, priest of Iroas

quotes.name: Woodland Cemetery
quotes.flavor: Farmers cut the trees and buried their dead. The dead rose up and killed the farmers. The trees grew back and strangled the dead.

quotes.name: Ripjaw Raptor
quotes.flavor: Raptors are clever enough to tear away a hard metal shell to get at the tasty morsel inside.

quotes.name: Pitiless Plunderer
quotes.flavor: "The trick to getting the biggest share is to be the last one standing."

quotes.name: Moonshaker Cavalry
quotes.flavor: "Conflict guided our lives and placed blades in our hands. Even after death, we know nothing else."

quotes.name: Concealing Curtains // Revealing Eye
quotes.flavor: Specifics were kept secret, but word quickly spread that the show was a must-see.

quotes.name: Thundering Spineback
quotes.flavor:
"It appears that nature has risen against us."
—Captain Brinely Rage

quotes.name: Wayfarer's Bauble
quotes.flavor: Anrakyr the Traveller awoke from his slumber with a singular goal: to rebuild a united Necron galaxy.

quotes.name: Last Night Together
quotes.flavor:
"The Towers sang, and you cried."
—River Song

quotes.name: Aven Flock
quotes.flavor: Just as each added feather steadies the wing, so does the flock grow stronger with each new member.

quotes.name: Firja, Judge of Valor
quotes.flavor: Invader after invader fell before her, and to each she spoke a single word: "Unworthy."

quotes.name: Gruesome Scourger
quotes.flavor: His whips twist and tremble like living things, moved by the fury of the horde he commands.

quotes.name: Provoke
quotes.flavor: Mirri did not have time to think, only to react.

quotes.name: Clinquant Skymage
quotes.flavor: Despite their advanced intellect, some aven never quite shake their instinctive need to collect shiny baubles.

quotes.name: Pyrotechnics
quotes.flavor:
"Hi! ni! ya! Behold the man of flint, that's me! Four lightnings zigzag from me, strike and return."
—Navajo war chant

quotes.name: Empyrial Armor
quotes.flavor:
"An angel appeared in the smoldering skies above the fray, her clothes as flames, her armor as fire."
—"Hymn of Angelfire"

quotes.name: Acidic Soil
quotes.flavor: Phyrexia had tried to take Urza's soul. He was relieved that Shiv tried to claim only his soles.

quotes.name: Sparksmith
quotes.flavor: "If it didn't hurt, how would I know it worked?"

quotes.name: Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak
quotes.flavor:
"Fear not the fall. Fear never reaching the pinnacle."
—Narset

quotes.name: Blood-Chin Fanatic
quotes.flavor: "We are as brutal as our dragonlord. We strike like wild lightning and feast on human flesh."

quotes.name: Archangel Avacyn // Avacyn, the Purifier
quotes.flavor:
"Wings that once bore hope are now stained with blood. She is our guardian no longer."
—Grete, cathar apostate

quotes.name: Draconic Lore
quotes.flavor: The wyrmling studied the ancient carvings and dreamed of a day when her own exploits would be immortalized in stone.

quotes.name: Elemental Augury
quotes.flavor:
"It is the changing of perception that is important."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

quotes.name: Suq'Ata Lancer
quotes.flavor:
"Never stop 'til you see your lance come out the other side."
—Telim'Tor

quotes.name: Cathars' Crusade
quotes.flavor: Avacyn's holy warriors kept hope alive in her darkest hours. Now they will carry that hope across Innistrad.

quotes.name: Ziatora's Proving Ground
quotes.flavor: Restless Riveteers can always find a sparring partner in the sprawling Treza warehouse.

quotes.name: Dreadmalkin
quotes.flavor: The feline Eternal felt Liliana's command, looked at her disdainfully, flicked its paw, and scampered away across the rooftops.

quotes.name: Impulse
quotes.flavor: "You call it luck. I call it preparation."

quotes.name: Act of Treason
quotes.flavor: Seen through Rakdos eyes, a cruel betrayal is a hilarious stunt.

quotes.name: Fungusaur
quotes.flavor: Rather than sheltering her young, the female Fungusaur often injures her own offspring, thereby ensuring their rapid growth.

quotes.name: Shipwreck Dowser
quotes.flavor: Lost at sea doesn't have to mean lost forever.

quotes.name: Pithing Needle
quotes.flavor: Occasionally a skaab remembers too much of its former life. Luckily, there's an easy cure.

quotes.name: Zuran Spellcaster
quotes.flavor:
"A mage must be precise as well as potent; cautious, as well as clever."
—Zur the Enchanter

quotes.name: Ghirapur Guide
quotes.flavor: Fairgoers were delighted to find that even outside the fairgrounds, Ghirapur was a city of wonders.

quotes.name: Acolyte of Bahamut
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: You were on a wayward path until Bahamut showed you that power and kindness can unite beneath the same banner.

quotes.name: The Mindskinner
quotes.flavor: It slices away the most precious memories first, then the mundane, until all that remains is blank, formless fear.

quotes.name: Granite Gargoyle
quotes.flavor:
"While most overworlders fortunately don't realize this, Gargoyles can be most delicious, providing you have the appropriate tools to carve them."
—The Underworld Cookbook, by Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

quotes.name: Souldrinker
quotes.flavor: Don't drink and thrive.

quotes.name: Ancient Craving
quotes.flavor: Knowledge demands sacrifice.

quotes.name: Feral Instinct
quotes.flavor:
"If a rhino's head is lower than its shoulders, trust me—it is *not* praying."
—Mwani, Mtenda herder

quotes.name: Agadeem's Awakening // Agadeem, the Undercrypt
quotes.flavor:
"Now is the death-hour, just before dawn. Wake, sleepers, and haunt the living!"
—Vivias, Witch Vessel

quotes.name: Wishful Merfolk
quotes.flavor: She yearned to walk on dry land so she might take her vengeance there.

quotes.name: Blight Mamba
quotes.flavor: Its venom drips with Phyrexia's hate.

quotes.name: Enlightened Tutor
quotes.flavor:
"I do not teach. I simply reveal."
—Daudi, Femeref tutor

quotes.name: Extruder
quotes.flavor: As the invasion drew closer, Urza's means began to resemble Phyrexia's end.

quotes.name: Skulltap
quotes.flavor:
"Finally, a use for that head of yours."
—Braids, dementia summoner

quotes.name: Unsummon
quotes.flavor: Not to be. That is the answer.

quotes.name: Thespian's Stage
quotes.flavor: Amid rumors of war, the third act of *The Absolution of the Guildpact* was quickly rewritten as a tragedy.

quotes.name: Thundercloud Elemental
quotes.flavor: Some days it's better to stay inside.

quotes.name: Blinding Light
quotes.flavor: An angel's sword impales only the body; her righteousness penetrates the soul.

quotes.name: Commander Greven il-Vec
quotes.flavor: "Rage is the only freedom left to me."

quotes.name: Rampant Growth
quotes.flavor: Nature grows solutions to her problems.

quotes.name: Eyetwitch
quotes.flavor: Oculomancers see the ideal potion ingredient. The bats don't see it that way.

quotes.name: Warden of Evos Isle
quotes.flavor: On Evos Isle, the swift and formidable aven enforce the will of the ruling sphinxes.

quotes.name: Kongming, "Sleeping Dragon"
quotes.flavor: "Such a lord as this—all virtues' height—Had never been, nor ever was again."

quotes.name: Trygon Predator
quotes.flavor: Held aloft by metabolized magic, trygons are ravenous for sources of mystic fuel.

quotes.name: Dawn's Truce
quotes.flavor: "I have a child I want to return to as well," whispered Mabel.

quotes.name: Bottle Gnomes
quotes.flavor:
"I am reminded of the fable of the silver egg. Its owner cracks it open to see what jewels it holds, only to discover a simple yellow yolk."
—Karn, silver golem

quotes.name: Sun Titan
quotes.flavor: A blazing sun that never sets.

quotes.name: Norwood Ranger
quotes.flavor: Some trees bear deadly fruit.

quotes.name: Finale of Eternity
quotes.flavor: When you rule by fear, your greatest weakness is one who's no longer afraid.

quotes.name: Tundra Wolves
quotes.flavor:
"I heard their eerie howling, the wolves calling their kindred across the frozen plains."
—Onean scout

quotes.name: Zombie Apocalypse
quotes.flavor:
"There will come a day so dark you will pray for death. On that day your prayers will be answered."
—Minaldra, the Vizag Atum

quotes.name: Woodborn Behemoth
quotes.flavor: It carries the hopes of Zendikar's embattled wilds on its mighty boughs.

quotes.name: Harbor Guardian
quotes.flavor:
"Our guardian levies a tax on all traders. Wise travelers pay with a minimum of fuss."
—Qhattib, Vizier of Amiqat

quotes.name: Frondland Felidar
quotes.flavor:
"Fear not the behemoth heard from miles away. Fear the stalking felidar, which reveals itself only for the kill."
—Rielle, the Everwise

quotes.name: Ohran Frostfang
quotes.flavor: Silent as a snowdrift. Inexorable as an avalanche.

quotes.name: Behind the Scenes
quotes.flavor: It does no good to bar the gate when the enemy is already inside.

quotes.name: Bitterbloom Bearer
quotes.flavor: Petals burst in evening hours with flitting things so fickle and sour.

quotes.name: Savaen Elves
quotes.flavor: "Purity of magic can only come from purity of the land. How can a meal nourish if the ingredients are spoiled?" —Sidaine of Savaen

quotes.name: Stupor
quotes.flavor:
There are medicines for all afflictions but idleness.
—Suq'Ata saying

quotes.name: Personify
quotes.flavor:
"I found myself wishing I could run away and start anew. That's when I saw those yellow eyes."
—Yenn, kithkin nomad

quotes.name: Plague Rats
quotes.flavor: During the dark times, the rats seemed to grow ever stronger.

quotes.name: Spell Pierce
quotes.flavor:
"A fool's fire is quickly quenched."
—Shaper Kumena

quotes.name: Preordain
quotes.flavor: "Before that night I first saw you, I had a premonition. A succession of disconnected images. A stone angel. You. A blue box called a TARDIS."

quotes.name: Hollow Dogs
quotes.flavor: A hollow dog is never empty. It is filled with thirst for the hunt.

quotes.name: Sheltered Thicket
quotes.flavor:
"This is a great spot . . . . Traders run close enough for easy pickins, but not so close that we end up skinned."
—Sully's Log

quotes.name: Invisibility
quotes.flavor: Verick held his breath. Breathing wouldn't reveal his position, but it would force him to smell the goblins.

quotes.name: Choose Your Champion
quotes.flavor: "I am nothing if not fair. I've chosen my champion. Now you must choose yours."

quotes.name: Dying to Serve
quotes.flavor:
"I used to have hired hands, but I discovered they make better waitstaff with the rest of the body attached."
—Olivia Voldaren

quotes.name: Harmonize
quotes.flavor: "Words lie. People lie. The land tells the truth."

quotes.name: Etherium Sculptor
quotes.flavor: Los más grandes maestros del arte abandonan todas sus herramientas, dando forma al metal sólo con las manos y la mente.

quotes.name: Bogstomper
quotes.flavor:
"They are gentle herbivores, despite their size. Approach cautiously, and hum a tune to let them know you mean no harm."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Crippling Chill
quotes.flavor: One breath of the geist turns veins to rivers of ice and freezes hearts midbeat.

quotes.name: Spectacular Tactics
quotes.flavor:
"Not bad, kid, but you've got a lot to learn."
—Spider-Woman, Jessica Drew

quotes.name: Juggletron
quotes.flavor: It's all fun and games until it drops a guest. Then it's a misdemeanor.

quotes.name: Hell's Caretaker
quotes.flavor: You might leave here, Chenndra, should another take your place . . . .

quotes.name: Fleeting Image
quotes.flavor:
"Beware lest you lose the substance by grasping at the shadow."
—Aesop, *Fables*, trans. Jacobs

quotes.name: Dark Ritual
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Phyrexia vs. the Coalition
quotes.flavor:
"From void evolved Phyrexia. Great Yawgmoth, Father of Machines, saw its perfection. Thus the Grand Evolution began."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

quotes.name: Stormcarved Coast
quotes.flavor: Frequent, violent storms shape the Nephalia coastline, sculpting cliffs and caves where monsters often lurk.

quotes.name: Novijen, Heart of Progress
quotes.flavor:
"The unnatural pressures of life in this city are best withstood by lifeforms that adapt with unnatural swiftness."
—Momir Vig

quotes.name: Arnyn, Deathbloom Botanist
quotes.flavor: "My lovelies need meat, just like any other carnivore."

quotes.name: Meteor Golem
quotes.flavor: The impact sent the soldiers scattering—then something came out of the crater.

quotes.name: Vedalken Orrery
quotes.flavor: The model incorporated the fifth sun effortlessly, as if it had always known.

quotes.name: Emissary Escort
quotes.flavor: Emissary mechans are often assigned their own security detail given their importance in inter-Pinnacle dialogs.

quotes.name: Epic Downfall
quotes.flavor: With Azula's defeat, all of her nobility, grace, and confidence shattered into harrowing screams from the would-be Fire Lord.

quotes.name: Mana Drain
quotes.flavor: "I suppose you've never heard of conservation of energy."

quotes.name: Thunderheads
quotes.flavor: The clouds grew thick, and then they grew teeth.

quotes.name: Lotus Cobra
quotes.flavor: Its passage through the flowering expanse doesn't disturb so much as a single petal.

quotes.name: Ichor Wellspring
quotes.flavor:
"Our glorious infection has taken hold."
—Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite

quotes.name: Deadeye Quartermaster
quotes.flavor: "Welcome aboard, mate! You're going to need this."

quotes.name: Agent of Kotis
quotes.flavor:
"I trust Narset. I do not trust those she keeps counsel with."
—Kotis, the Fangkeeper

quotes.name: Judith, Carnage Connoisseur
quotes.flavor: OWNER AND STAR OF HELLBENDER. A TRENDSETTER IN BOTH FASHION AND VIOLENCE.

quotes.name: Lightning, Army of One
quotes.flavor: "Lightning. It flashes bright, then fades away. It can't protect. It only destroys."

quotes.name: Wonderscape Sage
quotes.flavor: "I do not need to walk the land to find my way."

quotes.name: Ignite Disorder
quotes.flavor: "Bant is a world imprisoned by polished stone and tyrannical rule. It yearns to strike back against those who restrain it."

quotes.name: Target Minotaur
quotes.flavor: "Not again!"

quotes.name: Elusive Tormentor // Insidious Mist
quotes.flavor: Older vampires are usually more cautious than the newly-sired, calling upon ancient magic for which neonates lack patience.

quotes.name: Prairie Stream
quotes.flavor: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

quotes.name: Eternal Witness
quotes.flavor: "I have watched over this land since the first seedling emerged from the primeval soil."

quotes.name: Wood Elves
quotes.flavor: After the coming of Humans, the Wood-Elves took ever more and more to the gloaming and the dusk. Still Elves they were and remained—that is, Good People.

quotes.name: Feldon's Cane
quotes.flavor: Feldon found the first of these canes frozen in the Ronom Glacier.

quotes.name: Flashfreeze
quotes.flavor:
"Your downfall was not your ignorance, your weakness, or your hubris, but your warm blood."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

quotes.name: Silklash Spider
quotes.flavor: By the time the spider comes to slurp up its dinner, its victims have been partially dissolved by acidic silk.

quotes.name: Branching Evolution
quotes.flavor: The Master discovered a new evolutionary path after tossing a human, a dog, and a cat into a vat of Forced Evolutionary Virus. He called his creations "centaurs" and unleashed them unto the wastes.

quotes.name: Hellraiser Goblin
quotes.flavor: Don't let him lead the soldiers, but by all means let him lead the way.

quotes.name: Academy Ruins
quotes.flavor: The Tolarian Academy was home to some of the greatest discoveries in Dominaria's history—as well as its greatest tragedies.

quotes.name: Balduvian Rage
quotes.flavor:
"Let your heartbeat be the thunder in the valley. Let your swords be the lightning on the peaks."
—Lothar Lovisason, Balduvian chieftain

quotes.name: Smoke Bomb
quotes.flavor: When the sun removes all shadows, the Assassins create their own.

quotes.name: Mother of Runes
quotes.flavor: She will not touch a weapon, yet she is the greatest protector her people have ever known.

quotes.name: Deadbridge Goliath
quotes.flavor: Some Golgari insects live for centuries—and they never stop growing.

quotes.name: Elder Druid
quotes.flavor: "I may seem wise to you, but I'm merely a sapling among mighty oaks."

quotes.name: Goblin-town Flunkies
quotes.flavor: Goblins made no beautiful things, but they made many clever ones.

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

quotes.name: Armored Pegasus
quotes.flavor: Asked how it survived a run-in with a bog imp, the pegasus just shook its mane and burped.

quotes.name: Geistlight Snare
quotes.flavor: Tamil had always wanted a closer look at a geist's lantern. Now he had an eternity to study one.

quotes.name: Dismiss
quotes.flavor:
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny."
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Loam Larva
quotes.flavor: The forest floor of Murasa is home to life as diverse and vibrant as that of the canopy above.

quotes.name: Tombfire
quotes.flavor: The fondest memories burn brightest. As they're lost forever, the flames grow hotter still.

quotes.name: Depart the Realm
quotes.flavor: "My home calls to me, I must go."

quotes.name: Thirsting Bloodlord
quotes.flavor: "A whole life, full of memories and experience, love and sorrow, drained drop by drop into this bottle. Could any feast be more glorious?"

quotes.name: Vision Quest
quotes.flavor: "Is there a problem, Wanda?"

quotes.name: Rummaging Goblin
quotes.flavor: Goblins' eager curiosity leads them to scavenging, petty theft, and the rigging of sleek pirate ships. Some stop at scavenging.

quotes.name: Kin-Tree Severance
quotes.flavor:
"For his crimes—burn his blood and cut him from his ancestors. Perennation is only for family."
—Dictate of House Mevak in the banishment of Oret

quotes.name: Master Splicer
quotes.flavor: Phyrexian artificers remove the flesh they no longer need and use it to bring their unholy creations to a greater semblance of life.

quotes.name: Forest
quotes.flavor: The lights in the cavern glow and fade, glow and fade in a rhythm that must have a deeper meaning, if only you can figure it out.

quotes.name: Soul's Fire
quotes.flavor: An avatar he sculpts of anger and flame.

quotes.name: Abyssal Specter
quotes.flavor: To gaze under its hood is to invite death.

quotes.name: Abuelo's Awakening
quotes.flavor: Quintorius touched the old poncho he'd found. A rush of magic condensed into an Echo, and wise Abuelo stepped forth.

quotes.name: Faceless Haven
quotes.flavor: It is everywhere and nowhere, a place unbound by logic, just beyond the real.

quotes.name: Beluna's Gatekeeper // Entry Denied
quotes.flavor: "And what makes you think Lady Grandsquall wants to see *you*, little one?"

quotes.name: Volcanic Spite
quotes.flavor: None may approach the Ashen Idol without an offering—an edict fortuitously absent from Phyrexian intelligence concerning the world of Azgol.

quotes.name: Returned Reveler
quotes.flavor: The flesh is dead and the life forgotten, but old habits persist.

quotes.name: Onulet
quotes.flavor: An early inspiration for Urza, Tocasia's Onulets contained magical essences that could be cannibalized after they stopped functioning.

quotes.name: Frantic Inventory
quotes.flavor: "Another village, another angry mob. Why do I even bother unpacking?"

quotes.name: Myr Galvanizer
quotes.flavor:
"We can't quite determine what they're doing, but they seem to be doing it quite well."
—Vedalken research notes

quotes.name: Gilded Lotus
quotes.flavor:
"The perfection of the lotus reminds me of my hopes for this world . . . and my failures. I will not rest until I've atoned for them."
—Karn

quotes.name: Accumulated Knowledge
quotes.flavor:
"Learn not only from the failures of the past, but also from its triumphs."
—Isperia

quotes.name: Ajani Goldmane // Ajani Goldmane
quotes.flavor: Catcher

quotes.name: Wolfhunter's Quiver
quotes.flavor:
"Steel in the heart, silver in the bow."
—Wolfhunter's creed

quotes.name: Confiscation Coup
quotes.flavor: "Citizens, do not resist. This is for your safety. Tezzeret bids you to surrender your inventions. Now."

quotes.name: Lu Meng, Wu General
quotes.flavor: As the Wu chief commander, Lu Meng conquered Shu-held Jingzhou in 219 by disguising soldiers as merchants on boats filled with hiding troops.

quotes.name: The Ozolith
quotes.flavor: As it twists, so does all life around it.

quotes.name: Blightstep Pathway // Searstep Pathway
quotes.flavor:
"Our brave Tuskeri brethren blaze new trails, and we follow, mapping the routes of those who survive."
—Solrun, Beskir warrior

quotes.name: Compulsive Research
quotes.flavor: "Four parts molten bronze, yes ... one part frozen mercury, yes, yes ... but then what?"

quotes.name: Nature's Spiral
quotes.flavor: Like nature, the fern spirals back on itself, eternally seeking its own center.

quotes.name: Avatar Roku, Firebender
quotes.flavor: "Make sense of our past, Aang, and you will bring peace, and restore balance to the world."

quotes.name: Kozilek's Predator
quotes.flavor: It's difficult to outwit something that doesn't speak, strategize, or even think.

quotes.name: Energybending
quotes.flavor:
"Darkness thrives in the void, but always yields to purifying light."
—The Lion-Turtle

quotes.name: Sailor of Means
quotes.flavor: The rising tide of Orazca's plunder lifted all ships.

quotes.name: Mayael the Anima
quotes.flavor: The sacred Anima's eyes are blind to all but the grandest truths.

quotes.name: Rubblebelt Maaka
quotes.flavor:
"The maaka remain loyal to us in this time of strife. We don't even have to feed them—our enemies do."
—Nedja, Gruul shaman

quotes.name: Bounty Agent
quotes.flavor: "Lately I've seen the biggest bounties of my career—and for the biggest names."

quotes.name: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root
quotes.flavor: "Life is as fleeting as it is vibrant. Embrace the brief blessing of a flower before it withers."

quotes.name: Baithook Angler // Hook-Haunt Drifter
quotes.flavor: Even in death, he casts his lines, forever fishing for reasons long forgotten.

quotes.name: Turn to Frog
quotes.flavor: "Ribbit."

quotes.name: Haywire Mite
quotes.flavor:
"They're easy enough to squish, but they're a pain to wash out of a workbench."
—Tergel, goblin explosioneer

quotes.name: Rune Snag
quotes.flavor:
"Concentration is key. Without it, a mage conjures nothing but a splitting headache."
—Zur the Enchanter

quotes.name: Worship
quotes.flavor:
"Believe in the ideal, not the idol."
—Serra

quotes.name: Crackling Emergence
quotes.flavor: The transition from spiritual to material is sometimes as shocking as it is beautiful.

quotes.name: Fatestitcher
quotes.flavor: "Destiny be darned."

quotes.name: Prodigal Pyromancer
quotes.flavor: "What am I looking at? Ashes, dead man."

quotes.name: Tragic Slip
quotes.flavor: Linger on death's door and risk being invited in.

quotes.name: Darksteel Plate
quotes.flavor:
"If there can be no victory, then I will fight forever."
—Koth of the Hammer

quotes.name: Bleachbone Verge
quotes.flavor:
"Despite being older than nearly every living thing here, Loot is still just a kid. That doesn't change what we need from him."
—Jace

quotes.name: Collector Ouphe
quotes.flavor:
"He steals power from treasure after treasure, and what does it do for the ouphe? Nothing."
—Jhoira

quotes.name: Tempest Djinn
quotes.flavor: The first to arrive on Dominaria from their distant home, the marids are the oldest tribe of djinn and the most respected by storm and sea.

quotes.name: Now for Wrath, Now for Ruin!
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: The Captains of the West came at last to challenge the Black Gate and the might of Mordor.

quotes.name: Juniper Order Ranger
quotes.flavor: To protect the alliance between Kjeldor and Yavimaya, they trained in the ways of both.

quotes.name: Frost Trickster
quotes.flavor: The most important skill in a Mage Tower match is keeping one's cool.

quotes.name: Memory Lapse
quotes.flavor: Each scale glitters, a momentary distraction from everything that matters.

quotes.name: Psychic Trance
quotes.flavor: The Riptide Project was perhaps the only school devoted to preventing the spread of knowledge.

quotes.name: Cutthroat Contender
quotes.flavor: The fights may sometimes be rigged, but the front-row spectators know the wounds are real.

quotes.name: Capashen Templar
quotes.flavor: Their shields are Benalia's outermost battlements.

quotes.name: Necrotic Wound
quotes.flavor: The assassins of the Ochran distill toxins from the remains of their previous victims.

quotes.name: Nahiri's Warcrafting
quotes.flavor: "Zendikar must be broken before it can be saved."

quotes.name: Greed
quotes.flavor: What is a sliver of one's soul compared to unimaginable wealth?

quotes.name: War Priest of Thune
quotes.flavor: "The sacred might of Thune thunders in my soul."

quotes.name: Renegade Silent
quotes.flavor: "Silence will fall."

quotes.name: Hulldrifter
quotes.flavor: This car is what dreams are made of.

quotes.name: Deathbonnet Sprout // Deathbonnet Hulk
quotes.flavor: They grow up so fast.

quotes.name: Tovolar's Huntmaster // Tovolar's Packleader
quotes.flavor: "Do you smell that, friends? Fear and despair."

quotes.name: Vesuva
quotes.flavor: It is everywhere you've ever been.

quotes.name: Lurking Green Dragon
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"Territorial. Scary. No further notes."
—Volo's field notes

quotes.name: Punctuate
quotes.flavor: "Ooh—right in the colon."

quotes.name: Helica Glider
quotes.flavor: It could subsist on seeds but its preferred fare is your face.

quotes.name: Curse of Disturbance
quotes.flavor: Sounds of life beckon many a restless soul.

quotes.name: Fierce Empath
quotes.flavor: "Here, kitty, kitty, kitty . . ."

quotes.name: Leveler
quotes.flavor: Once a century, the levelers rip through every corner of Mirrodin, obeying the commands of an unseen master.

quotes.name: Confidence from Strength
quotes.flavor:
"Prepare for battle!"
—Jiang Yanggu

quotes.name: Trial of Zeal
quotes.flavor: "Eternal glory awaits you, my child."

quotes.name: Dryad of the Ilysian Grove
quotes.flavor:
"Vine-wreathed, he nurtures life among the dead."
—Psemilla, Meletian poet

quotes.name: Ageless Entity
quotes.flavor: Tel-Jilad's sworn protectors are the trolls, yet more fearsome protectors were created by the Tangle itself.

quotes.name: Leshrac's Rite
quotes.flavor:
"Bind me to thee, my soul to thine. I am your servant and your slave. Blood for blood, flesh for flesh, Leshrac, my lord."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Mistbreath Elder
quotes.flavor:
Where you are is temporary. What you do is forever.
—Frogfolk saying

quotes.name: Makeshift Battalion
quotes.flavor: Their ranks are thin, their formation is improvised, their weapons are borrowed, and you'd best get out of their way.

quotes.name: Nanogene Conversion
quotes.flavor: "Are you my mummy?"

quotes.name: Read the Bones
quotes.flavor: The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.

quotes.name: Memorial Vault
quotes.flavor: Kavaron cannot be saved, but its culture can.

quotes.name: Markov Warlord
quotes.flavor: "What use is a stake or holy symbol in the hands of a coward?"

quotes.name: Phyrexian Vindicator
quotes.flavor:
"Behold your inevitable defeat."
—Elesh Norn

quotes.name: Hurloon Minotaur
quotes.flavor: The Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle. They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike. These hymns can last for days, filling the mountain valleys with their low, haunting sounds.

quotes.name: Dream Pillager
quotes.flavor: Its wings shimmer with dreams absorbed from its enemies.

quotes.name: Izzet Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Beyond lies the culmination of all Izzet projects, a grand experiment led by the dragon Niv-Mizzet himself.

quotes.name: Go for the Throat
quotes.flavor: Having flesh is increasingly a liability on Mirrodin.

quotes.name: Howling Banshee
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Garruk vs. Liliana
quotes.flavor: Villagers cloaked the town in magical silence, but their ears still bled.

quotes.name: Mercurial Pretender
quotes.flavor: The king went off to find himself. Imagine his terror when he succeeded.

quotes.name: Abrade
quotes.flavor:
"What do you mean a walking clock destroyed all our cannons?!"
—Captain Lannery Storm

quotes.name: Razorkin Hordecaller
quotes.flavor: "Know your place, pets! First blood is mine!"

quotes.name: Irencrag Feat
quotes.flavor: The greatest challenge isn't the stifling heat but the crushing weight of those who failed before.

quotes.name: Vryn Wingmare
quotes.flavor: It's the favored mount of military commanders as well as anyone with a flair for the dramatic.

quotes.name: Mindwrack Harpy
quotes.flavor: Harpies are among the most detested creatures in all of Theros... and they thoroughly deserve it.

quotes.name: Run Away Together
quotes.flavor: True love means always knowing what's on the other's mind.

quotes.name: Sublime Exhalation
quotes.flavor: Exhale, and let the winds carry your soul for all eternity.

quotes.name: Ivory Mask
quotes.flavor: Made from its wearer's hopes, the mask ensures that those hopes will be fulfilled.

quotes.name: Gravewaker
quotes.flavor: It glides on silent wings across the midnight sky, and a dread host rises to follow.

quotes.name: Captivating Crew
quotes.flavor: "We sail. We plunder. Then we dance."

quotes.name: Kraven the Hunter
quotes.flavor: "I have found honor, not in the civilized, but in the primal."

quotes.name: Sanctum Gargoyle
quotes.flavor: As their supplies of etherium dwindled, mechanists sent gargoyles farther and farther afield in search of salvage.

quotes.name: Tui and La, Moon and Ocean
quotes.flavor:
"Our strength comes from the spirit of the moon; our life comes from the spirit of the ocean. They work together to keep balance."
—Princess Yue

quotes.name: Koll, the Forgemaster
quotes.flavor: Using tyrite from a fallen Cosmos monster, Koll forged a weapon to awe Halvar himself.

quotes.name: Skyshroud Elite
quotes.flavor:
"Civilization is a conspiracy to disguise the mutilation of nature."
—Skyshroud elite creed

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

quotes.name: Persist
quotes.flavor: Action: Show a kithkin (see pg. 28) emerging from under the ground where he was buried.

quotes.name: Eternal Warrior
quotes.flavor: Warriors of the Tsunami-nito School spend years in training to master the way of effortless effort.

quotes.name: Utility Knife
quotes.flavor: "Hold on a second, I have just the thing."

quotes.name: Thran Dynamo
quotes.flavor:
"The 'pinnacle' of advancement is a concept that exists only in the narrow minds of those with no ambition."
—Yawgmoth

quotes.name: Sculpting Steel
quotes.flavor: An artificer once dropped one in a vault full of coins. She has yet to find it.

quotes.name: Drop Tower
quotes.flavor: "Um, technically you can't 'drop' in space. What you—AIIIIEEEEEEE!"

quotes.name: Borne Upon a Wind
quotes.flavor:
"I looked on Aragorn and thought how great and terrible a Lord he might have become, had he taken the Ring for himself. Not for naught does Mordor fear him."
—Legolas

quotes.name: Goldmeadow Harrier
quotes.flavor:
"It's a proven fact that sling-stones from the dawn side of the riverbank sail the farthest and truest."
—Deagan, cenn of Burrenton

quotes.name: Meeting of Minds
quotes.flavor:
"If something seems impossible, you probably haven't tried asking for help."
—Niambi, cleric of Dominaria

quotes.name: Pacifism
quotes.flavor:
"If only they'd all act this docile. I could do something relaxing for a living. I've always wanted to bake biscuits."
—Ethuk, Coppercoat mage

quotes.name: Phyrexian Gargantua
quotes.flavor: Other Phyrexians have nightmares about the gargantua.

quotes.name: Phytotitan
quotes.flavor: Its root system spans the entire floor of the jungle, making eradication impossible.

quotes.name: Bedevil
quotes.flavor: Whenever Valgavoth sheds his old form, a Harrowing courses through the House like a malevolent wave, spawning new horrors and inciting its inhabitants to frenzy.

quotes.name: Generous Patron
quotes.flavor:
"Look at the crowd, folks!"
—Blitzball announcer

quotes.name: Elemental Bond
quotes.flavor:
"I want to help Zendikar. Show me the way."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Demonmail Hauberk
quotes.flavor: It comes off as easily as your own skin.

quotes.name: Shattered Sanctum
quotes.flavor:
"The most cordial words are often the ones intended to deceive. It's only of late that I've realized how much strength honesty requires."
—Embrose, dean of shadow

quotes.name: Lay Down Arms
quotes.flavor: She'll swing a blade all her life, but never again for war.

quotes.name: Korvold, Fae-Cursed King
quotes.flavor: Becoming a dragon only sharpened his raw ambitions.

quotes.name: Seismic Sense
quotes.flavor: "Even though I was born blind, I've never had a problem seeing ... I feel the vibrations in the earth, and I can 'see' where everything is."

quotes.name: Fulminator Mage
quotes.flavor: "Burn, suffer, and trouble me no more."

quotes.name: Duress
quotes.flavor:
"Give of yourself, for *compleation* awaits the cleansed."
—Nokar, priest of Sheoldred

quotes.name: Bloodtracker
quotes.flavor: "Flee all you like. The further you run the more firmly I feel your heartbeat."

quotes.name: Ultimate Alliance
quotes.flavor:
"When you said 'no man can equal you'? You had to know that was just begging for Jen to hit you."
—Spider-Man, Peter Parker

quotes.name: Eye of Ugin
quotes.flavor: An eye closes. A race awakens.

quotes.name: Perplexing Test
quotes.flavor: "Your proofs were a bit nontraditional, but effective nonetheless. Full marks."

quotes.name: Carrier Thrall
quotes.flavor:
"Later we will mourn those we have lost. First we must end their suffering."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

quotes.name: Sure-Footed Infiltrator
quotes.flavor: "I've yet to discover the ruin that can keep me out."

quotes.name: Despondent Killbot
quotes.flavor: "click . . . click . . . beep . . . whirrrr . . ."

quotes.name: Slaughter the Strong
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: It was a big day for the gravediggers at Cliffside Cemetery.

quotes.name: Simic Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.

quotes.name: Fade into Antiquity
quotes.flavor:
"Are the gods angry at our discontent with what they give us, or jealous that we made a thing they cannot?"
—Kleon the Iron-Booted

quotes.name: Force of Negation
quotes.flavor: Not even the most scathing critics can break her concentration.

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor:
"It's not hard to grasp that this land does not belong to us."
—Gavi, nest warden

quotes.name: Life Burst
quotes.flavor: As uplifting as a mystic's dreams.

quotes.name: Oversold Cemetery
quotes.flavor: It was a profitable scheme, at least until the dead began to object.

quotes.name: Supernatural Stamina
quotes.flavor:
"All are not equal—neither in life nor after death. Bontu's favorites will stand highest in eternity."
—Senifet, vizier of Bontu

quotes.name: Loyal Subordinate
quotes.flavor: Zombies work best when they're fed appropriately, so it's prudent to let them eat on the job.

quotes.name: Woodland Cemetery
quotes.flavor: Farmers cut the trees and buried their dead. The dead rose up and killed the farmers. The trees grew back and strangled the dead.

quotes.name: Thought Monitor
quotes.flavor: It roams the skies over the Quicksilver Sea, alert for any hint of aberrant thought.

quotes.name: Pariah
quotes.flavor: A valiant knight's life has no meaning without honor.

quotes.name: Wild Celebrants
quotes.flavor: "You can tell something's really valuable by the sound it makes when you slam your staff into it."

quotes.name: Flagstones of Trokair
quotes.flavor: Dust-spiked winds eroded the stones, but the ground where they had stood still holds power.

quotes.name: Horizon Seed
quotes.flavor: In peaceful times, these beings escorted the honored kami to their new shrines. In the Kami War, they became the medics of an unstoppable army.

quotes.name: Prismatic Omen
quotes.flavor: In times of portent, the land sculpts itself in accordance with the sigils burned on the sky.

quotes.name: Telling Time
quotes.flavor: Mastery is achieved when "telling time" becomes "telling time what to do."

quotes.name: Goblin Javelineer
quotes.flavor: Hate gets you only so far. A pointy stick can close the rest of the distance.

quotes.name: Syphon Flesh
quotes.flavor: Necromancers deal in commodities far more precious than gold and grain.

quotes.name: Flying Crane Technique
quotes.flavor: There are many Jeskai styles: Riverwalk imitates flowing water, Dragonfist the ancient hellkites, and Flying Crane the wild aven of the high peaks.

quotes.name: Sea Gate Oracle
quotes.flavor: "The secret entrance should be near."

quotes.name: Qumulox
quotes.flavor: Even the clouds bend themselves to Memnarch's will, eager to swallow those who oppose him.

quotes.name: Varragoth, Bloodsky Sire
quotes.flavor: "I waded through a river of fire to bring death to Bretagard."

quotes.name: Mutational Advantage
quotes.flavor: "Ow, my pipe!"

quotes.name: Wirewood Symbiote
quotes.flavor:
"Let the wild in. Channel its strength."
—Freyalise

quotes.name: Jared Carthalion, True Heir
quotes.flavor: "I'm here for what's mine."

quotes.name: Persistent Petitioners
quotes.flavor:
"...we need seeds, yo."
"Lots of seeds, and..."

quotes.name: Chaos Warp
quotes.flavor: Their lives stretched before them, each more magnificent than the last.

quotes.name: Prize Pig
quotes.flavor: The habit of building farmhouses and barns began among the inhabitants of the Marish down by the Brandywine.

quotes.name: Spirit Cairn
quotes.flavor: It marks the border between here and hereafter.

quotes.name: Corpsejack Menace
quotes.flavor: Weakness is not in the nature of the Swarm.

quotes.name: Clay Statue
quotes.flavor: Tawnos won fame as Urza's greatest assistant. After he created these warriors, Urza ended his apprenticeship, promoting him directly to the rank of master.

quotes.name: Relentless Raptor
quotes.flavor: As the battle for Orazca unfolded, the contenders discovered that others had already staked a claim.

quotes.name: Intimidator Initiate
quotes.flavor: Don't stand in his way, for his way is full of pointy things and fire.

quotes.name: Knights of Thorn
quotes.flavor:
"With a great cry, the goblin host broke and ran as the first wave of knights penetrated its ranks."
—Tivadar of Thorn, History of the Goblin Wars

quotes.name: Sunweb
quotes.flavor: Sometimes the wings of fallen dragons refuse to give up the sky.

quotes.name: Syphon Mind
quotes.flavor:
"Initiating brain wave transferal protocol."
—Ultron

quotes.name: Thorn Elemental
quotes.flavor: Rain from this storm leaves you pinned to the ground like an insect.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Bloodstock
quotes.flavor: It reeks of terror and chaos.

quotes.name: Fencer's Magemark
quotes.flavor:
"The first blow is the most important. It often negates the need for a second."
—Agrus Kos

quotes.name: Craw Wurm
quotes.flavor: The most terrifying thing about the Craw Wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

quotes.name: Ethersworn Adjudicator
quotes.flavor: Esper mages devised their weapons to be so devastating that war seemed unnecessary.

quotes.name: Gempalm Incinerator
quotes.flavor: "I've got this under control! Probably!"

quotes.name: Drana, Liberator of Malakir
quotes.flavor: "I will not live as a slave. If you would be free, then fight alongside me."

quotes.name: Ravenous Chupacabra
quotes.flavor: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

quotes.name: Voltaic Key
quotes.flavor: The key did not work on a single lock, yet it opened many doors.

quotes.name: Tranquil Expanse
quotes.flavor: Beyond the chaos of Ghirapur lies a vibrant world where aether flows through nature.

quotes.name: Dragon Mantle
quotes.flavor:
"With reckless courage, Cade embraced the flame.
He vowed they wouldn't dare forget his name."
—"The Night of Dragonfire"

quotes.name: Runed Stalactite
quotes.flavor: When a changeling adopts a form no other changeling has taken, a rune appears in the caverns of Velis Vel to mark the event.

quotes.name: Hypnotic Specter
quotes.flavor: "...There was no trace/ Of aught on that illumined face..." —Samuel Coleridge, "Phantom"

quotes.name: Hawkeye's Shot
quotes.flavor: "Keep 'em coming! I've got a full quiver and nowhere else to be!"

quotes.name: Wall of Roots
quotes.flavor:
"Mana grows and changes like the roots of a plant. Like a plant, it must be nurtured."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Crown of Awe
quotes.flavor: "Honor, guide my step."

quotes.name: Moor Fiend
quotes.flavor:
"Let them close the gates of Krov from dusk until dawn if they so choose. It matters not. My fiends shall yet rend their flesh from their bones."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Sulfurous Blast
quotes.flavor: The Keldons used the toxic vents in the cracked earth to bolster their home's defenses.

quotes.name: Irrigated Farmland
quotes.flavor:
"Sure, there are prettier farms in the Commonwealth, but none of them know how to grow tarberries like we do."
—Wiseman

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor:
"The blademaster turned his fury to his new foes: root rot and cabbage slugs."
—*Myths and Miracles, Vol. VII*

quotes.name: Kinsbaile Skirmisher
quotes.flavor: "If a boggart even dares breathe near one of my kin, I'll know. And I'll not be happy."

quotes.name: Squad Captain
quotes.flavor: The strength of the one is the strength of the many.

quotes.name: Brain Gorgers
quotes.flavor: In spite of their hunger, they're slow eaters.

quotes.name: Circuits Act
quotes.flavor: Another day, another item Pietra has to add to the "do not juggle" database.

quotes.name: Syncopate
quotes.flavor: "Your eyes, they burn with resolve . . . beautiful."

quotes.name: Wedding Invitation
quotes.flavor: RSVP at your own risk.

quotes.name: Amonkhet Raceway
quotes.flavor: Stage 2: The sands and waters of Amonkhet.

quotes.name: Funeral March
quotes.flavor:
"Turn the key deftly in the oiled wards,
And seal the hushed casket of my soul."
—John Keats, "To Sleep"

quotes.name: Lingering Souls
quotes.flavor: The murdered inhabitants of Hollowhenge impart to the living the terror they felt in death.

quotes.name: Silhana Wayfinder
quotes.flavor: "Stay close! It's just a little farther."

quotes.name: Traverse the Outlands
quotes.flavor: With such great footsteps, everything is within walking distance.

quotes.name: Wandering Archaic // Explore the Vastlands
quotes.flavor: "Fly the path of nine birds."

quotes.name: Aether Storm
quotes.flavor:
"I do love the rain . . . but this storm feels somehow wrong, Taysir."
—Daria

quotes.name: Thresher Lizard
quotes.flavor: The sound of its plated tail beating on desert rocks is often mistaken for the footfalls of a much larger predator.

quotes.name: Aerial Caravan
quotes.flavor: Successful delivery is *not* guaranteed.

quotes.name: Beast Whisperer
quotes.flavor: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."

quotes.name: Elvish Warrior
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Elves vs. Goblins
quotes.flavor: "My tales of war are the stories most asked for around the fires at night, but they're the ones I care least to tell."

quotes.name: Winged Coatl
quotes.flavor: The nacatl called this new species "vetli," their word for poison arrows.

quotes.name: Odric, Master Tactician
quotes.flavor: "Fear holds no place in faith's battle plan."

quotes.name: Flame Wave
quotes.flavor:
"I hear the roaring of a wave whose waters are red and whose mists are black."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Return of the Wildspeaker
quotes.flavor: "The curse is broken."

quotes.name: Lhurgoyf
quotes.flavor:
"Ach! Hans, run! It's the lhurgoyf!"
—Saffi Eriksdotter, last words

quotes.name: Elvish Lyrist
Sigurd, Jarl of Ravensthorpe
quotes.flavor: "And now we sail for further shores . . . to my true purpose."

quotes.name: Rage Reflection
quotes.flavor: La venganza es un plato que se sirve mejor dos veces.

quotes.name: Edric, Spymaster of Trest
quotes.flavor: "I am not at liberty to reveal my sources, but I can assure you, the price on your head is high."

quotes.name: Sheltered Aerie
quotes.flavor: Dromoka's scalelords patrol the skies over Arashin, offering her people safety from the harsh world.

quotes.name: Jump Scare
quotes.flavor: "Boo!"

quotes.name: Soltari Crusader
quotes.flavor:
"Carry war to the Dauthi, no matter the way, no matter the world."
—Soltari battle chant

quotes.name: Vodalian Hexcatcher
quotes.flavor: "You're just one more pollutant to be removed from the sea."

quotes.name: Curse of Bounty
quotes.flavor: Flavorful aromas beckon many a salivating maw.

quotes.name: Rib Cage Spider
quotes.flavor: Everything it sees it considers food—and with that many eyes, it's not liable to miss much.

quotes.name: Izzet Signet
quotes.flavor: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

quotes.name: Balemurk Leech
quotes.flavor: Adapted to feed on dead flesh, it's not averse to making its own when no corpses are available.

quotes.name: Funeral Rites
quotes.flavor: Funerary masks help the newly dead resist the erosion of memory and identity in the Underworld.

quotes.name: Sunpetal Grove
quotes.flavor:
"I wish I could live in a place like this. Peaceful... living with a smile on my face every day."
—Yuna

quotes.name: Sokka, Bold Boomeranger
quotes.flavor: "I'm just a guy with a boomerang!"

quotes.name: New Generation's Technique
quotes.flavor: "Uno, Moja, Odyn, and Yi carry on the brothers' legacy. New York will be free once more."

quotes.name: Colossal Whale
quotes.flavor:
"And in the night from Otherworld beyond the Sea there strong and free a storm arose . . ."
—*Song of Eärendil*

quotes.name: Stone Idol Generator
quotes.flavor:
"Like my people's ambitions, it is both awe-inspiring and unfinished."
—Nahiri

quotes.name: Savai Triome
quotes.flavor: Broad prairies feed the human sanctuary of Drannith and conceal a network of caverns where giant cats make their dens.

quotes.name: Meekstone
quotes.flavor:
"When it oscillated above a particular frequency, the stone induced acute listlessness in several researchers."
—Consulate engineer's log

quotes.name: Shrapnel Blast
quotes.flavor: It requires immense pressure to imbue an item with magic. If the spell is broken . . .

quotes.name: Enshrouding Mist
quotes.flavor: True faith is letting the blade fall without parry. True cunning is using that moment to strike a deadly blow.

quotes.name: Ogre Sentry
quotes.flavor:
"You have to appreciate the genius of it. Why bother building defenses when you can just fill the pass with angry ogres?"
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter
